audit.whatIsWrong: The chart was the opposite of its own prose on six of seven rows. mid opens 'This is your stable stretch', whys[1] through whys[6] all describe Maokai winning, and spikes[3] explicitly confines Heimerdinger's window to Level 1 — yet the chart credited him with levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items and called 4-5 and 6 'Skill'.
audit.why: The lane's actual shape is that Heimerdinger owns exactly one stage: level 1, before Maokai has a combo. From level 2 a point-and-click 525-range root against a mage with no dash decides every subsequent stage. The packet chart says Skill then Maokai on all six remaining rows, and the mirror audit flipped its side's rows 1 through 6 for the same reason.
audit.corrected: phases[1..6].side and win[1..6] all set to Maokai as matched full+content pairs in one group, ratings raised to 7/10 — the inverse of the mirror's 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phase why was boilerplate naming no spike; packet.defects also notes no Heimerdinger ability is ever named there.
audit.why: The spikes are concrete and numeric: level 2 for the point-and-click root, level 3 once Sapling Toss can thin the turret line from 1100, 4-5 once W falls to 11s and Q to 5.5s against a flat 11s grenade, and 6 for a 3000-range root through his own turret wall.
audit.corrected: All seven phase whys rewritten with those numbers and the real ability names.
sources: ownerKit E range 1100, W cd 14/13/12/11/10, Q cd 7/6.5/6/5.5/5, R range 3000

audit.whatIsWrong: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is described everywhere as 'his self-peel stun. Dodge it' with no cooldown and no mechanic. Riot's text: it stuns only 'anyone directly hit' and merely slows surrounding units, and it is 11 seconds at every rank.
audit.why: The direct-hit distinction is the whole counterplay — clipping the edge costs a slow, not a stun, so the Maokai does not have to abandon a commit because the grenade landed near him. And a cooldown that never scales means the window is identical at every level, which makes it the cleanest thing in the lane to count.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, phases[3].why and tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere stated the load-bearing fact that Heimerdinger has no dash or escape.
audit.why: It is why a targeted 525-range root ends the interaction: once Maokai arrives, there is no answer in the kit. The page hints at it once in whys[2] ('a dash-less mage') and never uses it.
sources: enemyKit: no dash flag on any ability

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Heimerdinger contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: He plants a turret and fires Micro-Rockets from 1325 while you hold one ability. Soak XP, stay out of the nest, concede level 1.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade is down.
edits.after: Level 2 flips it: Twisted Advance is point-and-click and he has no dash. Once you are on him he cannot leave. Bait the grenade first.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Heimerdinger must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Sapling Toss reaches 1100 — thin the turret line from outside it, then W in on him, never on the turrets, and Q him off his platform.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around CH-2 Grenade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His grenade is 11s flat at every rank; your W drops to 11s and Q to 5.5s. You repeat the trade faster than he can answer it.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp reaches 3000 and roots him through his own turret wall. A mage with no dash caught by that dies to any jungle path.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on CH-2 Grenade's cooldown.
edits.after: Heartsteel HP lets you walk rocket poke and reset on Sap Magic between every shove.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Heimerdinger carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on he cannot duel a healing tank. His danger moves to turret zones on objectives — engage him, don't siege him.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: matchup-defining — 11s at every rank, 970 range; only a direct hit stuns. Commit after he throws it. - Hextech Micro-Rockets: 1325 range, 7s late. - UPGRADE!!!: 100s, empowers one spell.

edits.before: W-root Heimerdinger the moment his answer is down, Q-knockback the follow-up, and let brush saplings tax his every path.
edits.after: W-root him the moment the grenade is thrown — he owns no dash — then Q him off the turret nest and sapling the line he rebuilds.
